name: The Audrey
description: An all-day restaurant and cocktail bar in the middle of Oyster Bay village. It has free live acoustic music on weekend nights, plus karaoke and trivia, and the bar stays open until 12:30 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.

dancing.notes: It is one room with tables and a bar. Music is mostly solo or duo acoustic acts at the bar with no cover, and a reviewer also mentions DJ and karaoke nights. We found nothing about a dance floor, so any dancing is likely limited to a small space near the bar.

evidence.note: The bar's own page: live music through the season plus karaoke nights, no cover, with acts playing at the bar.
Local feature (Aug 2026) describing one room with live acoustic acts on Friday and Saturday nights, karaoke and trivia.
